title: Argo CD + Gitea: Webhooks, Auto-Sync & Auto-Prune
description: Replace Argo CD's polling with a real Gitea webhook, then let automated sync — self-heal and prune included — do the rest without a human ever clicking Sync

steps.title: Push the app, wire up automated sync from the start
Webhook: push to instant sync, not a multi-minute poll
Self-heal: drift reverted before you can even check
Auto-prune: delete it from Git, watch it vanish from the cluster
